Retrieve, Store, Clear, or Inspect a Coding Cache

Source: R/cache.R
cache_operations.Rd

Low-level helpers operating on an coding_cache() object. All keys are validated strictly against path traversal and unsafe characters; disk cache writes are atomic and integrity-checked via SHA-256 checksums.

Usage

cache_get(cache, key)

cache_set(cache, key, value)

cache_clear(cache)

cache_stats(cache)

Arguments

cache

An object of class "llm_coding_cache".

key

Character cache key (typically produced by cache_key()).

value

R object to store in the cache.

Value

  • cache_get() returns the cached object or NULL on a miss (or after gracefully evicting a corrupted disk entry).

  • cache_set() invisibly returns TRUE if written, FALSE if caching is disabled.

  • cache_clear() invisibly returns the cache object.

  • cache_stats() returns a named list with type, dir, hits, misses, writes, evictions, and entries.

Examples

mc <- coding_cache("memory")
k <- cache_key("u1", "p1", "m1")
cache_set(mc, k, list(score = 4.5))
cache_get(mc, k)
#> $score
#> [1] 4.5
#> 
cache_stats(mc)
#> $type
#> [1] "memory"
#> 
#> $dir
#> NULL
#> 
#> $hits
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $misses
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $writes
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $evictions
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $entries
#> [1] 1
#> 
cache_clear(mc)
